title: Underwriter
description:
As an Underwriter at Splitero , you will make risk assessment decisions on applications for our Home Equity Investment (HEI) product, a modern alternative to traditional financing with no income requirements or monthly payments. In this pivotal role, you will analyze risk factors against our underwriting guidelines, policies, and procedures, and partner closely with our Processing team and homeowners to bring files to closing with clarity and purpose.
About the Job

• Own your pipeline from initial review through final approval, maintaining a consistent daily review cadence and meeting quality standards measured through regular QA review of your files.

• Identify the right conditions for each file: purposeful, proportionate, and defensible, and communicate the reasoning clearly to processors and homeowners.

• Ensure title to the property is free of restrictions, leases, liens, and other encumbrances, and identify the specific conditions needed to cure any title issues.

• Conduct thorough appraisal reviews, identifying value concerns, property condition flags, and comparables that may affect the investment decision.

• Review and analyze loan modifications to assess their impact on lien position, product features, and eligibility.

• Review trust documentation to confirm vesting, trustee authority, and compliance with Splitero guidelines.

• Monitor and approve that all conditions are met prior to funding.

The salary range for this position is $90,000 - $110,000 per year. Within the range, individual pay is determined by job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
About You

• 3+ years of experience underwriting residential real estate or home equity products.

• Deep experience reviewing and analyzing credit reports, property title reports, appraisal reports, mortgage statements, deeds of trust, and recorded instruments such as loan modification agreements and UCC filings.

• Strong title curative knowledge: you understand what specific conditions are needed to resolve liens, encumbrances, and title exceptions, and you can explain the why clearly.

• Strong appraisal review skills, including the ability to identify value concerns, property condition issues, and unsupported comparables.

• Solid understanding of loan modifications, including their impact on lien position, product features, and how they factor into the underwriting decision.

• Trust review experience is a significant plus, with familiarity with trust vesting, trustee authority, and the documentation needed to confirm homeowner eligibility.

• A calibrated, purposeful approach to conditioning: you ask what each condition is curing, condition with precision, and can provide your reasoning to processors and sales in plain language.

• A collaborative communicator who sees processors and homeowners as partners and gives context with every condition, not just a list.

• A creative problem solver who approaches complex files with curiosity and finds ways to get homeowners across the finish line.

• Experience with loan processing systems or robust CRM systems such as Salesforce.

• Incredible attention to detail, ensuring accuracy and thoroughness in every aspect of your work.

• The ability to work efficiently and independently on your pipeline.

• Availability to work until 6pm PST strongly preferred

• Adaptability: Embraces change with resilience and positivity.

• Team Oriented: Prioritizes collaboration, inclusivity, and teammate support.

About Us
Millions of homeowners in today’s economy are sitting on substantial home equity they are unable to access due to rising interest rates and strict qualification requirements of traditional lenders. That means millions of homeowners can’t convert their hard-earned equity into cash to pay off debt, start a home renovation, or pad their retirement to better their lives.
Splitero co-founders Michael Gifford and David Zvaifler witnessed the problem firsthand throughout their real estate careers

title: Scientist I/II, Characterization and Composition Analysis
description:
Your Impact at LILA

Lila Sciences is seeking a Scientist I/II, Characterization and Composition Analysis to join the Materials Science team within the Autonomous Science Platform. The Autonomous Science Platform combines experimental science, automation, AI, and software to accelerate materials discovery. This role turns elemental measurements into trusted, machine-readable composition data that supports scientific decisions, automated workflows, and model development.

This is a hybrid experimental and software-facing role, centered on hands-on characterization with substantial analyzer development. You will work with X-ray fluorescence (XRF), SEM-based energy-dispersive spectroscopy (SEM-EDS), wavelength-dispersive spectroscopy (WDS), and related analytical instruments. You will develop and validate methods, prepare standards and calibrations, execute measurements, interpret spectra, and troubleshoot issues from instrument, sample-preparation, and data-quality.

You will also design, write, and maintain the analyzer software behind these workflows. Partnering with AI, software, and automation teams, you will build spectral processing, quantification, automated data ingestion, metadata, provenance, and quality-control systems that make characterization outputs reliable, traceable, and useful at scale.

The ideal candidate is credible at both the instrument and the keyboard: strong experimental judgment in elemental characterization, paired with the ability to turn measurement expertise into shared, tested code and production-quality data workflows.

What You'll Be Building

• Own data quality and integrity for elemental and materials characterization workflows.

• Develop XRF, EDS, and WDS methods, calibrations, and QC procedures.

• Prepare standards, run samples, interpret spectra, and troubleshoot measurement issues.

• Lead investigations for anomalous or out-of-specification data and determine data validity.

• Design, write, and maintain analyzer software for spectral processing and quantification in partnership with machine learning team.

• Build automated data ingestion, metadata, provenance, and quality-control workflows.

• Maintain instrument readiness through calibration, documentation, SOPs, and troubleshooting.

• Support safe operation of general materials characterization workflows (profilometry, XRD, SEM).

• Help evaluate, bring online, and develop methods for new analytical detectors as we expand characterization capability.

• Collaborate with hardware, automation, AI, and software teams to scale trusted data generation.

What You'll Need to Succeed

• PhD in Materials Science, Chemistry, Physics, Engineering, or a related field, or M.S. with equivalent hands-on characterization experience.

• Hands-on experience with XRF, SEM-EDS, and WDS for elemental analysis.

• In-depth knowledge of the physical principles behind XRF, EDS, and WDS analysis, including signal generation, matrix effects, calibration, quantification, and common sources of error.

• Strong understanding of calibration, quantification, spectral interpretation, and data-quality control.

• Experience preparing standards, validating methods, and troubleshooting measurement issues.

• Experience writing analysis notebook and maintaining shared, tested code in a version-controlled codebase.

• Proficiency with Python or an equivalent coding environment for data analysis, automation, or analyzer development.

• Ability to translate characterization workflows into reliable, structured, machine-readable data.

• Clear communication skills for working across scientific, AI, automation, and software teams.

Bonus Points For

• Experience with EPMA or related elemental microanalysis workflows.

• Experience with broader characterization techniques such as electron microscopy, optical microscopy, XRD, XPS, ICP-OES, ICP-MS, SIMS, or related analytical methods.

• Familiarity with spectral quantification or analysis tools such as fundamental parameter

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril's Air Dominance & Strike (AD&S) Manufacturing Engineering team is seeking a Propulsion Manufacturing Engineer to provide subject matter expertise on propulsion system manufacturing across our portfolio of autonomous aircraft, cruise missiles, and loitering munitions. This position may be filled at either the Senior or Staff level depending on experience and qualifications. This role covers the full spectrum of propulsion technologies relevant to AD&S - air-breathing jet turbines, ramjets, and solid rocket motors - and is responsible for ensuring that propulsion hardware can be manufactured, assembled, tested, and integrated at production rate with the quality and reliability our programs demand.
You will bring deep expertise in the manufacturing processes, materials, and quality requirements specific to propulsion systems. Your knowledge of how these systems are built - from turbine blade casting and combustor fabrication to solid propellant processing and nozzle manufacturing - is what makes you valuable. You are the person who knows what can go wrong in propulsion production and how to prevent it through design influence, process control, and supplier qualification.
A critical part of this role is working directly with design engineers and program-level manufacturing engineers to evaluate propulsion designs for producibility, drive DFM improvements, and support the selection and qualification of propulsion suppliers and contract manufacturers. You will also support propulsion system test campaigns from a manufacturing engineering perspective, including integration, acceptance testing, and anomaly resolution. This is an inherently cross-functional role: you will work daily with supply chain, quality, operations, test engineering, and program teams.

• Serve as a propulsion manufacturing engineering subject matter expert across AD&S programs, covering air-breathing turbines, ramjets, and solid rocket motors.

• Evaluate propulsion system designs for manufacturability, assembly, and cost - leading or supporting DFM/DFA reviews and driving design changes that improve producibility without compromising performance.

• Work directly with design engineers and program manufacturing engineers to translate propulsion manufacturing constraints into actionable design feedback.

• Assist in the selection and qualification of propulsion suppliers and contract manufacturers - assessing manufacturing capability, process maturity, quality systems, and cost competitiveness for propulsion-specific production.

• Conduct or participate in supplier manufacturing assessments for propulsion hardware, including facility reviews, process audits, special process qualification (casting, brazing, propellant processing, thermal spray), and production readiness evaluations.

• Develop and maintain manufacturing process requirements and standards for propulsion-specific processes including turbine component manufacturing, combustor and hot section fabrication, solid propellant mixing and casting, nozzle manufacturing, and propulsion system assembly and integration.

title: 2027 Summer Intern, MS/PhD, Software Engineer, Simulation Evaluation ML Model
description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver-The World's Most Experienced Driver™-to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

Software Engineering builds the brains of Waymo's fully autonomous driving technology. Our software allows the Waymo Driver to perceive the world around it, make the right decision for every situation, and deliver people safely to their destinations. We think deeply and solve complex technical challenges in areas like robotics, perception, decision-making and deep learning, while collaborating with hardware and systems engineers. If you’re a software engineer or researcher who’s curious and passionate about Level 4 autonomous driving, we'd like to meet you. 

Waymo interns partner with leaders in the industry on projects that create impact to the company. We believe learning is a two-way street: applying your knowledge while providing you with opportunities to expand your skill-set. Interns are an important part of our culture and our recruiting pipeline. Join us at Waymo for a fun and rewarding internship!

 

You will:

• Design and implement an automated semantic extraction pipeline that parses large-scale simulation logs, vehicle trajectory data, and multi-agent behavioral events into structured graph representations (entities, temporal relationships, and causal interactions)

• Develop temporal graph modeling techniques to capture time-varying multi-agent interactions, road context, and safety-critical driving events

• Build a multi-modal hybrid retrieval engine (combining dense vector embeddings, keyword search, and graph traversal) to enable fast scenario discovery and serve as structured memory for automated failure analysis agents

• Create interactive data exploration tools and visualization dashboards (e.g., Jupyter/Colab-based explorers) to help autonomy engineers and researchers analyze complex scenario distribution

• Benchmark retrieval precision, recall, and query latency against traditional tabular and relational search baselines

• Collaborate cross-functionally with simulation researchers, machine learning engineers, and software infrastructure teams to document system architecture and establish roadmap recommendations

 

You have:

• Currently enrolled in a graduate program (PhD or Master’s) in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related quantitative field, with at least one academic term remaining

• Strong software development experience in Python and/or C++ in a Linux development environment

• Solid foundation in core computer science concepts, data structures, algorithm complexity, and distributed data systems

• Hands-on experience with modern deep learning frameworks (such as PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow)

 

We prefer:

• Demonstrated research background or practical experience in Knowledge Graphs, Graph Algorithms, Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), or Information Retrieval / Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

• Authorship of published papers in top-tier AI/ML, data mining, or computer vision conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, KDD, The Web Conference [WWW], CVPR, CoRL, SIGMOD, VLDB, ACL)

• Experience with large-scale distributed data processing systems (e.g., Apache Spark, Apache Beam, distributed SQL query engines, or columnar data lakes)

• Familiarity with temporal graphs, bi-temporal data modeling, or graph databases/tooling

title: Senior Manager, FCC Program Management
description:

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 676,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Financial Crimes Compliance team builds and oversees Airwallex’s global financial crime framework across AML/CTF, sanctions, risk assessment, FCC operations, monitoring and testing, and investigations. The team works closely with Product, Operations, Risk, Regulatory Legal & Compliance, and regional MLROs to make sure our controls are well designed, practical, and effective as Airwallex scales globally.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

As Senior Manager, FCC Program Management, you’ll lead a multi-year effort to strengthen Airwallex’s global financial crime framework as we scale across products and regions. This is a new role with broad scope: you’ll shape the target operating model, improve processes and systems, and bring stronger discipline to FCC-wide change. You’ll be the central connector across senior leaders and cross-functional teams, making sure work is practical, well sequenced, and built to stick in BAU.

 

This role is hybrid. Based in London.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Lead a global, multi-year FCC transformation across operating model, process, systems, testing, and controls.

- Build and drive the roadmap, with clear sequencing across priorities, dependencies, and risks.

- Use AI, automation, and data tools to improve FCC program tracking, reporting, and delivery across complex global workstreams.

- Run disciplined governance across working groups, SteerCos, RAID, and executive updates.

- Work hands-on with FCC and cross-functional leaders to turn complexity into clear plans, decisions, and action.

- Define success measures, evidence progress, and lead smooth transition into BAU.

 

WHO YOU ARE

We’re looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

 

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

- 10 years leading large, multi-workstream transformation programs in financial services or fintech.

- Direct experience in financial crime program change across areas such as AML/CTF, sanctions, FCC operations, and monitoring and testing.

- Practical experience using AI, automation, and modern tools to improve program planning, reporting, and execution in complex environments.

- A track record of delivering multiple global or multi-region programs at more than one complex institution.

- Highly organized, hands-on, and strong at turning complexity into action.

- Strong executive presence, clear communication skills, and project management certification such as PMP or PRINCE2.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

- Experience in fintech, payments, or digital banking, ideally in fast-moving, global environments.

- Background in consulting, regulatory remediation, or large-scale risk and compliance change.

- Strong proficiency with program tools, dashboards, and executive reporting.

title: Freelance - Learning Content Reviewer French
description:
FREELANCE LEARNING CONTENT REVIEWER: FRENCH (ALL GENDERS)

ABOUT BABBEL LABS

Babbel Labs is building the future of language learning. We're an AI-first, independent company within the Babbel group, based in Berlin. Our teams bring AI, R&D and product together to ship experiences that set a new standard for how people learn.

ABOUT THE ROLE AT BABBEL LABS

We're a small, fast-moving team rethinking how people learn languages with AI. We're looking for a detail-oriented freelance Learning Content Reviewer to make sure our French content is accurate, natural and genuinely useful, so learners pick up French the way it's really spoken and written. This is a freelance role, paid hourly.

Speed, precision and quality are how we work. You'll review content as it's created, including content produced with the help of AI, and help us catch what machines miss. Your feedback will directly shape what learners experience and how our curriculum grows.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Review learning content across formats. Check text, audio and images for accuracy, clarity, naturalness and consistency, and flag anything that could confuse or mislead a learner.

- Review and shape the curriculum. Assess how lessons build on each other, spot gaps or overlaps, and suggest improvements to structure, progression and learning goals.

- Ensure French content is authentic and current. Check grammar, spelling, register (tu vs. vous), idioms and cultural references, and make sure audio reflects natural French pronunciation.

- Quality-check AI-generated content. Evaluate content created with AI tools, identify recurring errors and help us improve how that content is produced.

- Give clear, actionable feedback. Document issues and suggestions in a way that content creators, linguists and engineers can act on quickly.

- Help raise the quality bar. Contribute to review guidelines, style standards and checklists that keep content consistent at scale.

- Work across disciplines with product managers, linguists, learning content strategists and engineers.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

- Relevant experience. 2+ years of experience in at least one of the following: proofreading, translation, language teaching, or learning content quality testing.

- Language skills. Native or near-native French, plus fluent English. Excellent oral and written communication skills in both.

- A sharp eye for detail. You notice the small things, from a mistranslated word to an audio clip that doesn't match its transcript.

- A learner-first mindset. You understand what makes content clear and motivating for someone learning a new language.

- Comfort with AI tools. You're curious about how AI is changing content creation and happy to use it as part of your workflow.

- Reliability and independence. You manage your own time, meet deadlines and communicate proactively when something needs attention.

- Comfort with ambiguity. You're happy working in a fast-changing environment where processes evolve as we learn.

WHAT YOU'LL GET

- A consumer product used around the world. Your reviews directly improve a live product that real learners use every day, globally.

- Meaningful impact. Your feedback shapes the content and curriculum, not just the final polish.

- Competitive hourly rate. Pay that reflects your experience and the quality of your work.

We are a learning company, inside and out, and we encourage you to apply even if you do not fit all the technical requirements - all candidates are assessed based on skills, qualifications and on our business needs. title: Onboarding Team Lead, Germany
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About the Team

Wolt's Shared Service Center in Budapest is home to a team of 40 people who keep our operations running across markets. Ten of them focus on one mission: getting German merchants to live on Wolt quickly and correctly. They own the onboarding journey from the moment a partner signs to the day they start receiving orders. Now we're looking for someone to lead them.

As Onboarding Team Lead, you'll be based in Budapest and work closely with our Onboarding Operations team in Germany, reporting to the Global Head of Business Process Outsourcing Management. You'll lead a team of 12 FTE, own the German onboarding pipeline, and make sure every partner gets a smooth, high-quality start on Wolt. The team is experienced and established, and it's ready for a leader who can raise the bar on speed, quality and process, while being its biggest advocate.

What you’ll be doing

You'll be responsible for how quickly and how well German merchants are onboarded onto Wolt. That means leading the people, owning the pipeline, and keeping a close eye on the numbers. You'll build a solid understanding of the full onboarding landscape, including POS integrations, gear workflows, commission changes and offboarding. You'll also be the go-to person when things get stuck.

Day-to-day in this role you’ll:

• Lead, coach and develop a team of 12 FTE onboarding specialists, support them daily, and spot knowledge gaps and training needs.

• Own the onboarding pipeline so it always reflects reality. New venues are assigned the same day, follow-ups and on-hold reasons stay up to date, and stalled cases get escalated or offboarded instead of left open.

• Track the team's key onboarding KPIs, such as time to onboard and new live venues, so you always know where the team stands and can flag deviations early.

• Work with Sales, Account Management, Product and the Onboarding Operations team in Germany to escalate blockers early and improve how we onboard.

• Keep data quality high by validating issues yourself before escalating, sharing bug reports daily, and making sure partner information is accurate and complete.

• Plan team capacity ahead of holidays, business trips and short weeks so no partner is ever left without an owner.

Our humble expectations

• You have at least 2 years of experience leading a team of 8 or more people, including setting clear performance expectations and following up on them.

• You have 3+ years of experience in operations in a fast-paced environment such as a marketplace, e-commerce or a shared service center.

• You're fluent in both German and English, written and spoken, because you'll work daily with German partners and stakeholders.

• You're comfortable working with data and use KPIs and dashboards to understand performance and make decisions.

• You're structured and detail-oriented, and you keep pipelines, timelines and data accurate without being chased.

• You take ownership, spot opportunities to improve processes, and drive changes independently.

What we offer

• A key leadership role shaping how merchants in one of Wolt's biggest markets join the platform.

• A team that's already up and running, so you can focus on raising the bar rather than starting from scratch.

title: Senior Database Administrator
description:
This is a remote position.
Embrace Healthcare Group powers some of the most innovative healthcare technology solutions in North America, with a focus on enhancing clinical efficiency and compliance across emergency care settings.
EPOWERdoc, a leading SaaS platform within the Embrace Healthcare Group portfolio, specializes in Emergency Department Information Systems (EDIS) tailored for hospitals of all sizes. Designed by clinicians for clinicians, EPOWERdoc streamlines emergency room documentation with intuitive workflows, customizable templates, peer-reviewed clinical content, and real-time coding assistance-helping providers reduce documentation time and focus more on patient care.
As we continue to scale our impact in the healthcare space, we are seeking passionate professionals to join our team. The Senior SQL Server Production DBA will be responsible for owning the health, performance, and lifecycle of every database that powers EPOWERdoc’s product across production, staging, and development environments.
This is a hands-on role managing dozens of customer-hosted, hybrid, and cloud instances. You will standardize basic database hygiene, including backups, index maintenance, performance tuning, scalability, and security. You’ll work side-by-side with architects, developers, Support, and IT teams to diagnose issues, provision new environments, and support our shift from on-premise installations to a future multi-tenant SaaS offering. If you’re a proactive database professional with a passion for clean, well-tuned systems, we’d love to hear from you!

Responsibilities

• Backup & Recovery: Design and implement robust backup strategies that ensure both full and transactional log backups run on schedule. Conduct regular restore tests to validate that Recovery Point Objectives (RPO) and Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) are consistently met.

• High-Severity Triage: Act as the primary responder for Sev-1 and Sev-2 database-related incidents. Drive timely root cause analysis and implement permanent solutions to maintain system stability and minimize future risks.

• Performance & Index Tuning: Continuously monitor wait statistics, index fragmentation, and resource-intensive queries. Provide clear and actionable tuning recommendations that improve query performance and reduce latency for high-impact customers.

• Capacity & Storage Planning: Track database file growth trends and forecast storage requirements at least 90 days in advance. Proactively engage with internal teams and customers to address potential disk space or I/O limitations before they become critical.

• Schema & Data Change Management: Review and validate SQL scripts submitted by development teams. Safely apply changes across customer environments while maintaining detailed version control and change history.

• Environment Provisioning: Develop and maintain repeatable scripts and runbooks for provisioning new environments or cloning databases. Support the efficient onboarding of new sites and refresh test environments as needed.

• Security & Compliance: Implement and enforce best practices for database security, including encryption at rest and in transit, least-privilege access controls, and comprehensive auditing. Ensure compliance with regulatory standards such as HIPAA.

• Process Improvement: Document and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs). Identify opportunities to automate routine database tasks-such as backups, integrity checks, and deployments-using scripting and lightweight DevOps pipelines.

• 5+ years of experience administering SQL Server (2016-2022) in 24×7 production environments, including on-premise and cloud-hosted setups.

• Strong knowledge of backup/restore strategies, index maintenance, performance tuning, and HA/DR solutions like Availability Groups, log shipping, or mirroring.

• Comfortable supporting customer-managed on-premise servers, VPN/ExpressRoute-integrated cloud VMs, and internal lab environments.

title: Staff Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Are you ready to shape the future of data?

Matillion is the company behind Maia, the AI Data Automation platform.

In the AI economy, demand for data is exploding. Manual data engineering can’t keep up. Maia fixes that by combining 15 years of data expertise with agentic AI to eliminate the manual work that slows data teams down. Organisations like Cisco, DocuSign, and Slack are already using it to deliver real business impact, faster.

We started in Manchester and now we’re global - with teams across the UK, US and India.

We are driven, curious, energetic people who move fast, think big and hold ourselves to a high standard. We’re here to make a dent in the universe bigger than ourselves. And we’re looking for people who want to be part of it.

The Staff Forward Deployed Engineer is the senior operator we put on our most significant and complex Maia rollouts and expansions. Working primarily remotely with our distributed teams and on-site when it counts, they own these engagements end to end, architecting and building production-grade solutions, modifying Matillion ’s own product code where the platform needs it, and holding the highest engineering bar under real delivery pressure.

A true force multiplier, they work at every level and across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success: earning technical wins, acting as a hands-on escalation point to Customer Success, and driving adoption and expansion in their accounts. They ship quickly and to standard in a low-friction way, turn their work into reusable assets and product feedback, and mentor the FDEs coming up behind them.

What you will be doing:

• Owning end-to-end customer engagements by running discovery, architecting multi-cloud deployments, writing production-grade code, and guiding projects through to production cut-over.

• Building complex data pipelines, models, and integrations across cloud data platforms to ensure customers achieve the core outcomes they adopted Maia for.

• Modifying Matillion ’s underlying codebase directly when native platform features are missing, adhering to strict engineering, security, and quality standards.

• Delivering fast, pragmatic MVPs by diagnosing real underlying customer problems, questioning initial requirements, and shrinking scope to accelerate platform adoption.

• Cultivating executive trust and serving as a cross-functional catalyst across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to resolve complex escalations at the first point of contact.

• Enabling total customer self-sufficiency by training internal champions and creating clear handover documentation for Customer Success and Support teams upon project exit.

• Securing technical wins during pre-sales cycles through technical discovery, proof-of-concept deliveries, objection handling, and joint strategy work with Account Executives.

• Influencing product evolution by identifying repeating delivery patterns, submitting structured product feedback, and building reusable implementation frameworks that minimize future custom work.

• Working agentic-first by integrating AI tools across the entire delivery lifecycle while setting clear quality validation standards for AI-generated outputs.

• Elevating team performance by mentoring junior engineers, shaping hiring standards, refining delivery processes, and continuously updating expertise in emerging AI and cloud tech.

What we are looking for:

• 5+ years of experience in production-grade software development and data integration, featuring expert Python, SQL, and object-oriented skills (Java/Go) for designing reusable architectures and refactoring complex codebases.

• Deep knowledge of distributed systems, data architecture, CI/CD, Kubernetes, secure enterprise networking, and at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

• Hands-on expertise in scalable data pipelines and cloud data platforms like Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift, or BigQuery, alongside familiarity with the broader Matilli

description:

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

As we grow the organisation, hiring the best people becomes one of our main priorities. You will do this by applying your strong hiring competences, effectively partnering with your Hiring Managers, implementing best hiring practices and partnering with other teams on various projects.

As a Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist you will focus on supporting our key tech areas, including Engineering, Product Management, Data Science & Analytics, Design, and Research, to ensure we secure the best talent for these functions (note: your specific focus may shift based on business needs).

title: Program Manager, Mapping Operations
description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver-The World's Most Experienced Driver™-to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

You will:

• Develop deep subject matter expertise on the Imagery component of mapping operations, and serve as a go-to point of contact for our vendor teams

• Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and own those solutions end-to-end

We prefer:

Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co http://applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. About the Role

We're looking for a Software Integration Engineer who can champion the delivery of features across our vehicle software stack. This role works across software and hardware to ensure the full system integrates seamlessly for customer delivery - from workstation and SIL through HIL and target hardware, including integrating customer SWCs against our generated AUTOSAR RTE.

- Work with customers and our business team to define target use-cases and requirement, then own the integration project to completion

- Work cross-functionally with product, software, mechanical, and electrical teams to develop and deploy systems

- Develop a deep understanding of the full system architecture and how software and hardware components interact

- Integrate customer-delivered SWC ARXML against the generated AUTOSAR RTE contract and runtime, taking a component from an either black-box/white-box app to running ECU code

- Work with the validation team to verify and integrate components, troubleshooting issues to ensure reliability across SIL, HIL, and target

We're looking for someone who has:

- 2+ years of experience in software integration or development

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science/Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical discipline

- Proficiency in embedded C/C++ programming

- An understanding of electronic systems and how to set up and debug them

- Familiarity with Linux development and Bash scripting

Nice to have:

- Experience working automotive communication protocols such as CAN, LIN, Automotive Ethernet, FlexRay, SENT, PSI5.

- Working knowledge of the AUTOSAR Classic Platform layered architecture: SWCs, the Virtual Functional Bus, ports/interfaces, runnables, and RTE events

- Experience with POSIX-based adaptive AUTOSAR: ara::com, service-oriented communication, execution management

- Experience reading or authoring ARXML, and integrating a black-box application against a generated Rte_* contract (headers, types, mocks)

- Experience developing software for large projects (CI/CD, release process, etc.)

- Comfortable programming in Python

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

description:
🎤 WHY VOIZE? BECAUSE WE’RE MORE THAN JUST A JOB!

At voize, we believe the greatest gift to frontline workers is time - time to care, connect, and be present. Today, that time is lost to busywork and complex systems that pull them away from what matters most: people.

Our vision is to change that by building AI companions that seamlessly take over digital workflows. We don't replace humans with technology - we amplify their impact.

Our mission is backed with a $50M Series A funding led by Balderton Capital, with support from HV Capital, Y Combinator and other leading VCs. Today, 2,000+ facilities trust voize, and over 200,000 users rely on our AI companion to ease their daily workload.

As a dynamic team, we combine first-in-class technology with meaningful social impact. And now, we’re looking for you to join us on this mission!

💡 YOUR MISSION

As a Care Expert, you are the trusted care advisor for voize's most important care group customers. Together with their Customer Success Manager, you make sure voize really changes how care teams work - not just that it goes live. You speak with QM-Leitungen and Pflegedienstleitungen as a peer, because you have done their job. Your success shows in adoption and in the time teams get back.

🚀 YOUR DAILY BUSINESS

- Support 6-10 strategic care group accounts as their care expert, side by side with their Customer Success Manager

- Look at QM processes, documentation routines and the EHR setup (e.g. Vivendi) before go-live, so mismatches surface early instead of during rollout

- Talk with QM-Leitungen and Pflegedienstleitungen as a peer about process design, how documentation is structured, and change management - in their language, not ours

- Review adoption with customer leadership after go-live and share clear, practical recommendations on voize settings and on care workflows

- Bring what you see across accounts back to our Product team, and name clearly what is a process topic, an EHR setup topic, or a real product need

🤝 YOUR SKILLSET

- You have worked as Pflegedienstleitung, QM-Beauftragte/r or in a similar senior care quality or operations role - at the level of the people you will advise

- You know QM processes, care documentation standards and EHR systems (ideally Vivendi/Snap) in stationärer Altenpflege

- You speak fluent German and can meet a careful Pflegedienstleitung, a cautious Geschäftsführung and a busy IT admin on the same day, each in their own way

- You think in a structured way and can tell whether something is a process topic, a system setup topic, or a change management topic - and what helps in each case

- You enjoy close collaboration: with CSMs, with Product, and on building the Care Expert playbook together

🌱 GROWING TOGETHER - WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT AT VOIZE

- We are a fast-growing startup, that means you will tackle new topics, grow quickly, and make a real impact, giving healthcare professionals more time for real patient care

- We foster an open, collaborative culture with regular team events, whether you work from our Berlin office or remotely from Germany

- Become a co-creator of our success with stock options

- Generous perks: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off, Germany Transport Ticket, Urban Sports Club, regular company off-sites, and access to learning platforms such as Blinkist and Audible

- You decide when you work best; that means flexible working hours and a good hybrid set-up.

✨ READY TO TALK? APPLY NOW! 🚀

We look forward to your application and can’t wait to meet you - no matter who you are or what background you have!
